correctness.rationale: For any symmetric 2-design, BB^T=B^TB=(k-lambda)I+lambda J over the binary field. The four cases of k,lambda parity yield respectively A^2=0; A^2=I; two J1(0) and v-1 J2(1); or one J2(1), 2(rho-1) J2(0), and 2v+2-4rho J1(0). The explicit J1(0), J2(0), J2(1) temporal transfers yield cyclic modules (X+1)^2,(X+1)^4,(X^2+X+1)^2. Their polynomial gcd with X^t-1 gives the exact E(t); necessary blocks have positive multiplicities, ensuring sharp 4/6/6/12 orders. Period-two states are absent for odd k and even lambda because the temporal module has only p(X)^2 primary blocks; all other stated least-period sets follow from primary-block combinations. The rank recovery follows from E(1)=2(v-rho). A direct GF2 matrix checker verified 72 nullities (six designs, times 1..12), and a separate per-vertex update census verified all states for the v=3 and v=4 cases. Universality follows from the proof, not finite testing.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The projective-plane theorem is a proper special case of the design statement (lambda=1); it is explicitly excluded from the new contribution. The strongly regular classification concerns adjacency graphs with diameter two, whereas a nontrivial symmetric 2-design incidence graph is bipartite of diameter three; the hypotheses and matrix identities are different. The latter result therefore does not subsume the claim.

value.rationale: Symmetric 2-designs are a natural full combinatorial incidence class; rank codes are classically significant. The four parity cases classify all dimensions and all characteristic-two finite-field extensions, not a handpicked parameter slice. Complementing the Fano plane changes the exact wave clock from 12 to 4, and lambda-even biplanes realize regimes absent from the lambda=1 subfamily. The temporal census also determines the binary design rank exactly. This is structurally informative independent of any downstream conjecture.
